# ScaleERP

> ScaleERP is a modern, offline-first inventory management, rapid billing, and ledger platform built for agricultural suppliers, feed retailers, and wholesale distributors.

ScaleERP combines a resilient offline Electron + SQLite desktop client with a cloud-synchronized licensing and telemetry engine built on Next.js 15, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase.

## Core Capabilities
- **Offline-First Resilience**: Full operational autonomy powered by local SQLite 3 in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode. Does not require internet connectivity for billing, inventory, or reports.
- **Cryptographic Offline Licensing**: Enterprise-grade RSA-2048 asymmetric signature verification (`.lic` files) bound to machine hardware fingerprints (CPU, Motherboard UUID, MAC address).
- **Sub-Second Thermal Billing**: High-velocity invoice creation with multi-format template engine (80mm Thermal, Standard A4, Modern Clean, Compact A5) and direct WhatsApp payment reminders.
- **Wholesale Broker & Ledger System**: Double-entry accounting, brokerage calculations, freight charges, and transaction rollback protections.
- **Anti-Tamper & 7-Day Grace Engine**: Automatic clock-tampering detection, 7-day grace period for expiring licenses, and Soft-Lock / Hard-Lock states.
- **Automated Cloud Backup**: Scheduled local SQLite snapshots with optional encrypted Google Drive synchronization.

## Core Documentation
- [Quick Start Guide](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/docs/getting-started/installation-and-license): Installation, first-run wizard, and license activation.
- [Inventory & Godown Operations](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/docs/inventory-godowns/manage-products): Stock tracking, multi-godown allocation, low-stock thresholds.
- [Retail Billing & Invoicing](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/docs/retail-customers/create-retail-bill): Counter sales, GST calculations, thermal print dispatch.
- [Wholesale Broker Ledgers](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/docs/wholesale-brokers/broker-ledgers): Commission tracking, consignment purchases, balance reconciliation.
- [Data Backups & Recovery](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/docs/backups-security/data-backups): Local backup scheduling and automated recovery procedures.
- [Cryptographic Licensing Protocol](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/docs/backups-security/offline-licensing): Offline asymmetric signing, envelope verification, and public key verification.

## Public Platform Links
- [Product Overview](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/product): Complete feature architecture, speed benchmarks, and comparisons.
- [Pricing Plans](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/pricing): Transparent pricing tiers with 30-day trial and perpetual options.

## Developer & Telemetry API
- [POST /api/v1/licensing/activate](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/api/v1/licensing/activate): Cryptographically signs license payloads using RSA-PSS SHA-256.
- [POST /api/v1/licensing/sync-heartbeat](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/api/v1/licensing/sync-heartbeat): Background workstation heartbeat check and entitlement updates.
- [GET /api/v1/download](https://scaleerp.vercel.app/api/v1/download): Release binary and portable installer distribution router.
